name: Game emulator
definition: Program that imitates a game console's, arcade board's or home computer's hardware so that its games run on the owner's computer or phone.
reason: Memo sentence 3 makes it I1; hosts another system like virtualisation, but imitates foreign hardware for games. Next free in I1.1.1.

name: Game engine
definition: Program and framework for building video games, with rendering, physics, scripting and an editor (Unity, Unreal Engine, Godot).
reason: Sentence 3: builds games without being one, so I1; a tool for writing and building code, licensed and compared as its own class.

name: Mod manager
definition: Program that downloads, installs, orders and switches game mods in a game's files without being a game or a mod itself.
reason: Sentence 3 makes it I1; mods are D5. Compared head to head (Vortex, MO2); a file-handling tool, so files leaf.

name: Download manager
definition: Program that queues, accelerates, pauses and resumes file downloads over HTTP, FTP and similar protocols.
reason: Internet access tool in its own right, beside BitTorrent client; compared as a class. Free Download Manager and Xunlei move here.

name: File manager
definition: Program for browsing, copying, moving, renaming and organising files and folders, often in two panes.
reason: Memo section 3 expects it in SF1 (S31, S05); no files-leaf kind browses folders. Commander One moves here.

name: Disk and file encryption software
definition: Program that encrypts whole drives, partitions, containers or single files so they open only with a key or password.
reason: Protects the owner's data (I1.2 job); not antivirus, password manager or VPN; compared as one class. I1.2 stays leaf-null.

name: Parental-control and content-filter software
definition: Program or hosted filter that blocks or limits web content, apps and screen time for chosen users or devices.
reason: Value is what the filter does, so I1 (sentence 1), not I3. Sold alone (Qustodio type); suite features stay attributes.

name: OCR software
definition: Program that turns scanned pages, images and image-only PDFs into editable, searchable text.
reason: Compared as one class across makers (C2(a)); a PDF editor's OCR feature stays an attribute. ABBYY FineReader moves here.

name: Desktop-publishing software
definition: Program for laying out multi-page documents such as magazines, books and brochures from text and images for print or screen.
reason: Page layout is its own technique (precedence: technique inside a medium); home publishing covers cards and calendars, graphic design app templates.

name: Input method editor
definition: Program that converts keystrokes into the characters of a language such as Japanese or Chinese, with conversion dictionaries.
reason: Sold and compared as its own program (ATOK); generic type, not regional (C11); placed with everyday writing tools, not device care.
